content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages payable by Customer)

- No liquidated damages, penalties, stipulated damages, shortfall charges or early-termination/minimum fees payable by AP appear anywhere in the Agreement — the preferred position is satisfied, so no redline was proposed.
- Section 5 is a revenue-share model in which money flows from Kubient to AP (within 7 days of Kubient's receipt); AP's only affirmative payment obligation is applicable sales/use taxes.
- The Section 4(a) carve-out entitling Kubient to "all fees generated during the termination period" is a revenue-share preservation on revenue actually generated during the 90-day notice window, not a Customer-payable termination fee, so it is not flagged.
- Section 7(a) mutually excludes punitive and special damages, reinforcing the absence of penalty exposure.
- Caveat recorded in the rationale: fee mechanics live in the Exhibits, which are outside this document and should be reviewed for any minimum-revenue or shortfall commitment payable by AP.
